practical_threshold.rationale: A fabricated smallest difference worth noticing, fixed before any value was inspected so that a statistically distinguishable but trivial difference cannot be presented as meaningful.
A fabricated smallest change in dispersion worth noticing. Lower dispersion is reported, never asserted to be better.

falsification_tests.description: Recompute the estimate without each pair in turn and report whether the direction ever changes.
Recompute the estimate without each block in turn; a direction carried by one block is fragile.
Remove the single pair furthest from the median difference and report whether the direction and practical magnitude survive.
Split the ordered pairs in half and report whether both halves carry the direction.
Estimate within each block separately and report whether the direction is isolated to one of them.

hypothesis: The reserved blocks show the same direction of difference as the primary scope.
limitations: This run reads the reserved blocks for the first time. If the direction does not reproduce here, the primary result does not become a finding.
Every value analysed here is fabricated; no racing conclusion follows from any number in this run.
A statistical result is not a finding, and a finding is not a product change.
null_hypothesis: The reserved blocks show no difference in segment minimum speed.
scientific_question: Does the primary result reproduce in the blocks reserved before construction?

source_declarations: At least 4 comparable within-driver pairs and at least 2 blocks for a mechanics-level contrast
sufficiency_rule.stopping_rule: Analysis runs once over the complete preregistered block set. There is no interim look and no rule permitting collection to continue until the result becomes attractive.

title: Declared replication over the reserved blocks alone

uncertainty.interval_semantics: Percentile interval over a deterministic cluster bootstrap that resamples whole blocks. It describes sampling variability of this estimator on this evidence and is not a probability statement about the true effect.
